title: Entry Process – WSER
claims: The 2027 Western States will be held 26–27 June 2027.
Applicants must be at least 18 on race day and finish a qualifying race within 3 November 2025 to 8 November 2026.
Lottery registration runs 1–21 November 2026 and the draw is on 5 December 2026.
The entry fee is USD 575 plus the online fee; selected runners have ten days to register or forfeit the place and accrued tickets.
The lottery also selects 75 applicants for an ordered general wait list.

claimVerification.note: 页面首行写 2027 年 6 月 26–27 日。
第 2–3 条写 11 月 1–21 日报名、12 月 5 日抽签。
第 5 条写 $575 + online fee、10 天完成注册。
第 7 条写 75 人 general wait list。
